raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer encountered repeated navigation issues and failed to collect the required historical temperature data from any reliable source. Despite multiple attempts to access NOAA and Weather Underground, WebSurfer did not successfully retrieve the necessary datasets. Instead of escalating the issue or clearly communicating the failure to the Orchestrator earlier, WebSurfer persisted in unsuccessful navigation attempts and did not propose practical alternatives or solutions, such as using APIs or requesting local datasets. This caused the process to stall and ultimately led to an estimation-based response that lacked the precision required to accurately solve the real-world problem.
